annotation.title_clean: Submission of the Center for AI and Digital Policy (CAIDP) to AGESIC on the Public Consultation on the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2024-2030
annotation.title_en: Submission of the Center for AI and Digital Policy (CAIDP) to AGESIC on the Public Consultation on the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2024-2030
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Center for AI and Digital Policy (CAIDP)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: CAIDP's October 2024 submission to Uruguay's AGESIC on the draft National AI Strategy 2024-2030. It finds the draft aligned with the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI and the Montevideo Declaration. It recommends a stronger human-rights approach, ethical impact assessments, and mandatory third-party audits. It has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Draft strategy aligns with the UNESCO Recommendation and the Montevideo Declaration
Recommends a stronger human-rights-based approach with safeguards for vulnerable communities
Recommends ethical impact assessments and consultation with affected communities
Recommends mandatory periodic third-party audits of AI systems used in public services
Commends the proposed AI Observatory as a multi-stakeholder monitoring body
